props.name: cellClassName
props.comment: A class name to apply to the cell element when used inside `<DataTable>`.

props.name: className
props.comment: A class name to apply to the root element.

props.name: empty
props.comment:
The node to display when the field value is empty. Defaults to nothing.
A string is translated; a ReactNode renders as-is.

props.name: headerClassName
props.comment: A class name to apply to the header cell element when used inside `<DataTable>`.

props.name: label
props.comment:
Label to use as column header when using `<DataTable>` or `<SimpleShowLayout>`.
Defaults to the capitalized field name. Set to `false` to disable the label.

props.name: lastUsedSource
props.comment:
Sibling record field with an ISO last-used timestamp. A top-level key, not
a path: the read is `record[lastUsedSource]`.

props.name: maskedFormat
props.comment: 'last4' shows the trailing 4 chars; 'full' masks everything.

props.name: record
props.comment: The record to render. Defaults to the ambient `RecordContext` value.

props.name: resource
props.comment: The resource name. Defaults to the ambient `ResourceContext` value.

props.name: scopesSource
props.comment:
Sibling record field with scope strings; renders chips when set. A
top-level key, not a path: the read is `record[scopesSource]`.

props.name: sortable
props.comment: Disable the header click handler when used inside `<DataTable>`.

props.name: sortBy
props.comment: The field to sort by when this column head is clicked, if sortable.

props.name: sortByOrder
props.comment: The order used for sorting when this column head is clicked, if sortable.

props.name: source
props.comment: Name of the property to display (dot/bracket path).

props.name: textAlign
props.comment: The text alignment for the cell content, when used inside `<DataTable>`.
